$comment: Planned territorial snapshots. Snapshots are DISCRETE: the timeline jumps between them, never interpolates. status=planned means no geometry exists yet - Phase 1 deliberately ships none. Each snapshot's `method` says what the geometry may be built from; `fallback` says what to show if evidence is insufficient. See docs/design/04-geographic-data-plan.md.
